(a) the word error rate of an OCR can be substantially reduced by using the entire document to constrain word recognition; (b) this can be done using a locality sensitive clustering algorithm; and (c) this can be applied to any OCR and any language.

developing a robust OCR for documents in Indic languages.
developing an OCR that is robust to errors in character recognition.

we are able to reduce the word error rate of the OCR by 20% on average and up to 40% in some cases.
the proposed method is robust and is applicable for any OCR system and any language.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of any OCR can be improved by fusing the results of multiple OCRs.
a simple and robust document level OCR may be built by using the results of a (regular) word OCR and a simple clustering of the word images.
the word level error rates of any OCR can be improved substantially by incorporating information from the whole document.
